title: Freelancer, consultant or creator
tagline: Design, code, writing, coaching, content — selling your own time and skill, in India or abroad.
who: Creators earning from brand deals, platforms and courses
Consultants who may hire a small team later

structure.recommended: Sole proprietorship on your own PAN
structure.why: Zero incorporation cost, one tax return, and — if you are in a specified profession — presumptive tax lets you declare 50% of receipts as income with no books or audit up to ₹75 lakh. Move to an LLP or private limited when you hire, take on liability-heavy contracts or want to bring in a partner.
structure.alternatives: OPC if a client insists on a company; LLP once a second partner joins.

timeline: You can invoice legally today on your PAN. GST (if needed) in 3–7 working days; LUT instant; everything else inside two weeks.
taxes: Income tax on slab rates; presumptive 50% rule (Section 58 of the 2025 Act, old 44ADA) up to ₹75 lakh for specified professions if ≤5% cash receipts, else ₹50 lakh.
GST registration mandatory above ₹20 lakh turnover (₹10 lakh in special states); exports of services are zero-rated under a LUT; domestic services carry 18%.
Clients deduct TDS at 10% under 194J (2% for technical services) — reclaim through your return; check Form 26AS/AIS.
Advance tax: presumptive taxpayers pay once by 15 March; others quarterly.
selling: Platforms: Upwork, Fiverr, Toptal, Contra (they may deduct TDS/GST TCS)
Courses and digital goods on Gumroad, Graphy, Teachable, Instamojo (foreign platforms acting as merchant of record simplify GST abroad)
sourcing: Your main input is software — claim GST input credit on subscriptions billed to your GSTIN if registered
pitfalls: Taking payments in a personal savings account and never separating business money — fine legally for a proprietor but ruinous for books and loans.
Receiving foreign money via friends/relatives or crypto to ‘avoid GST’ — exports under LUT are already 0% GST; the risk is FEMA, not tax.
Forgetting that GST registration is mandatory for *any* inter-state supply of goods (not services) and for selling through marketplaces.
Opting out of presumptive taxation one year locks you out for five.
